entities.summary: John Barden Shadegg is an American politician and former U.S. representative for Arizona's 3rd congressional district, serving from 1995 until 2011. He is a member of the Republican Party. John Shadegg was a legal figures from Phoenix (b. 1949-10-22, Phoenix). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
